Hi Sanjay — thanks for the heads up and for sending the W-9. Sorry for the friction. I want to get you a clean vendor record and invoice routing set up today. To help us triage quickly, can you confirm two quick things:

1) The legal entity name that should appear on the vendor record exactly as it appears on the W-9.
2) The email you used to sign up in the portal (is it procure@atlaslogistics.com?).

Quick checklist I will action once I have those:
- Validate EIN/TIN in our vendor master and correct any normalization mismatch.
- Create supplier record in Coupa under that legal name (or map to existing vendor if duplicate).
- Set invoice routing to AP@atlaslogistics.com and payment method to ACH.
- Attach W-9 to the vendor record and mark it as verified.
- Confirm remit address and update PO remittance fields.

If you prefer a quick call I can do a 15-min kickoff now — I'm available at 3:30pm PT today or 9am PT tomorrow. Otherwise reply with the two items above and I'll run the changes.

Also, for secure bank onboarding (if you're going to update ACH details) we'll send a secure link rather than email bank info.

Best,

Stephanie / Aditya — I'll own the Coupa vendor creation for Atlas Logistics once Sanjay confirms the legal name (he has). Plan:

1) Search for existing vendor aliases (Atlas Logistics, Atlas Logistics Inc) to avoid duplicate vendor creation.
2) Normalize EIN format (strip dashes) and run match against vendor master; if mismatch persists, I'll raise a vendor data case with Coupa support and attach their W-9.
3) Create vendor record with legal name "Atlas Logistics, Inc." and set invoice routing to AP@atlaslogistics.com.
4) Update PO/Invoice remit to: 120 Harbor Way, Suite 201, Oakland, CA 94607 (per W-9) and mark payment method as ACH.
5) Send secure bank detail collection link (do not accept ACH info over email). I'll generate the secure form and share the link with Sanjay.

I'll also attach the W-9 to the vendor profile and set a verification flag in the vendor record. If we encounter an API validation error (TIN mismatch), I'll include the error output and open a support ticket with Coupa; expect an update within 24 hours.

Laura Bennett
Vendor Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
